702.noahz: Dorian Noahz introduced himself as a tailor from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Orders assigned Dorian Noahz to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Dorian Noahz won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-F21. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is lost. Dorian Noahz heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bullet went through Dorian Noahz's sleeve at S-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008). A letter from home reached Dorian Noahz before dusk. Dorian Noahz read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dorian Noahz no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
The gun at S-F21 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Silas Kjellx, gravely wounded.
johnrant21: Nobody asked Clement "Lucky" Johnrant why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.' Clement "Lucky" Johnrant walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant fired at a movement across the wire at S-F16. The man went down: Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki, grazed.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

A bullet found Clement "Lucky" Johnrant at S-F16, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Dietrich Thky of the Hegemony (@haydnburrell_9thky). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was carried in at last.
The man in the next bed snored all day. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing.
Declared fit, Clement "Lucky" Johnrant reported back to S-F16. The familiar smell reached him before the familiar voices.
lettersabcd: Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd told the sergeant he was a dance-hall violinist. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
First Wave. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a frozen apple.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The party came back from Sorrow Copse by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd.
The missing report was still on the desk when Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.

Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd saw Edmund Callmequeeno freeze up on the fire step at Hill 304. Ghost said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F10. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd has learned to walk bent double.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal fired. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'

A bullet hit Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Dorian Austintress of the Hegemony (@austintress). Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Austintress of the Hegemony (@austintress).

A letter came with Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd: "I am Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. As one of the first hundred volunteers, Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
murilmoore.06: Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore arrived on Day 6 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
A letter reached Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore from Dunmarrow. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Casimir "Rabbit" Murilmoore drew the street leading to Dunmarrow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
the_john_military: Emil Military came from Halden, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Emil Military held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Emil Military held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F3, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Emil Military stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The corporal found out Emil Military used to be a baker. Emil Military has been doing two jobs ever since. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Military fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub Mccooper, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet found Emil Military at S-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Oskar Perry stood up to sing louder, and Emil Military fired. Oskar Perry was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
thebutcher5655: Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher arrived on Day 5 as a replacement. The men in R-S9 had been fighting for 4 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Victory at Hill 304. Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher of the Hegemony and Nils Zczc of the Concord watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
thewilliampoole: "You're late," said the corporal when Wendel Thewilliampo arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
virajvirxgill13: Nobody saw Jakub Virajvirxgil arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F16, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Lightning lit the Chalk Pits and Jakub Virajvirxgil saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F16 with the rations. Jakub Virajvirxgil ate while listening to the revised orders.
The guns found R-F16. Jakub Virajvirxgil was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
Jakub Virajvirxgil lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

There was never a bed for Jakub Virajvirxgil, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F16 on his own feet. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Jakub Virajvirxgil did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Jakub Virajvirxgil had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr crossed it, Jakub Virajvirxgil fired. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was grazed.
Jakub Virajvirxgil fired at a movement across the wire at R-F16. The man went down: Jonas Utku, grazed.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Oskar "Smokes" Guyy, badly wounded. Jakub Virajvirxgil cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Jakub Virajvirxgil had just lit a cigarette at R-F16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).
